content:
Alongside the now live Best Buy 4th of July sale, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by M5 iPad Pro at up to $350 off before the price hikes completely take hold at Amazon, alongside the last remaining M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs still live with pre-price hike deals (Up to $450 off). You can also grab the latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C cable from just $19 (up to 37% off) and load up on official Apple Watch Sport Bands while they are just $15 Prime shipped (69% off). Head below for a closer look.

Best Buy’s annual 4th of July sale now live: Apple, Android phones, TVs up to 45% off, appliances, and more

M5 iPad Pro up to $350 off before price hikes take hold at Amazon

Much like we have featured recently on MacBook Pro and iPad Air, there is still a chance to land the latest M5 iPad Pro at a pre-price hike rate. The base model 13-inch M5 iPad Pro, for example, now costs $1,499, but you can score one on Amazon down at $1,199.99 right now – that’s $300 off the most affordable 13-inch you can buy, and some models are as much as $350 off.

While the new, much higher list prices are appearing on Amazon for the M5 iPad Pro, there are still several configurations sitting down at discounted prices based on the previous MSRPs right now, and likely not for much longer:

M5 iPad Pro 11-inch:

  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $949 (Now Reg. $1,199)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,449 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $1,949 (Now Reg. $2,299)

M5 iPad Pro 13-inch:

  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,499)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 512GB $1,349 (Now Reg. $1,699)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,749 (Now Reg. $2,099)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $2,249 (Now Reg. $2,599)

Only a few M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs still live with pre-price hike deals, land one now at $450 off while you still can

We have done our best to warn folks of the imminent price hikes about to land at retail across the latest MacBook and iPad lineups. The new official prices are starting to flood in at Amazon on the latest M5, M5 Pro, and M5 Max machines but there are still a few at pre-price hike rates and if you’re looking to score a new machine anytime soon, you might want to consider doing it now.

The prices from yesterday have already jumped up $200 on these two configurations:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Now Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,374 (Now Reg. $2,499)

But all of the following options are still sitting at the prices we featured yesterday to deliver some giant discounts on the new MSRPs the M5 Pro is as much as $450 off and the M5 Max is still up to $650 off:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-Core $2,549 (Now Reg. $2,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-Core $2,749 (Reg. $3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,649 (Now Reg. $2,999)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 36GB/2TB $3,849 (Now Reg. $4,399)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/2TB $4,349 (Now Reg. $4,999)

Again, these prices could jump up a ton very soon, quite possibly before day’s end. While there’s no telling how things are going to shake out in the coming months, most projections suggest these Apple price hikes could remain for a lot longer than that. Deal pricing, as you can see on some of the machines above, might end up/are already landing higher than the old MSRPs.

Grab the latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C cable from just $19 (Up to 37% off)

There are loads of USB-C cables out there, but this new model Beats released this year delivers some more than respectable power passthrough at 240W, a longer run, and one of the more attractive designs out there. Having a bunch of cheapies laying around as extras or hidden away in your setup is great, but if I’m going to be traveling with just one or two, or have one to take to meetings and things like that, I think this Beats solution at up to 37% off with four color options is a solid option.

Amazon is now offering the Beats 240W USB-C to USB-C Braided Cable starting from $18.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

Carrying a $30 list price, this is as much as 37% off and the lowest price we can find. Only the Navy model is down quite this low right now, but the Stone and Black are only a few bucks more at the moment. Today’s deals deliver the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon outside of a brief stint down in the $17 range back in late April.

These are the same prices we featured as part of the early Prime Day offers, but in case you were distracted by the big ticket gear, we wanted to highlight this ongoing offer once again.

Again, there are more affordable options out there, but we are looking at a more premium solution than most, with 240W power passthrough action, a “tangle-free woven design for extra durability and convenience,” and a longer 3-meter run this time around.

Load up on official Apple Watch Sport Bands while they are just $15 Prime shipped (69% off)

Ultra-rare Prime Day deal still live live on latest black Apple Magic Mouse

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Woot’s charging accessories sale is back with up to 75% off: Anker 3-in-1 charging station, power banks, more from just $8
  • Skip the Apple tax and score this Dell 27-inch 4K 120Hz monitor for your Mac workstation while it’s down to $218 (2026 low)
  • Acer delivers a metal unibody design, 4K resolution, and 1/2-inch Sony sensor in this webcam for just $34 (Reg. $60)
  • This MagSafe desk pad tops off your iPhone and AirPods, now $30 (Reg. $60)
  • Upgrade how you water your yard/gardens with Aiper’s IrriSense 2 smart irrigation system & sprinkler for $370 ($130 off)
  • How to score the new Google Home Speaker at 50% off with this Best Buy 4th of July promo
  • Apple’s no-tool Link Bracelet band costs hundreds, this tool-free titanium alternative is only $70 right now

Selling out quick: You can still land M4 iPad Air at $350 off before the price hike hits Amazon

If you’re interested in an M4 iPad Air, or will be at some point in the relatively near future, don’t sleep on these deals. Amazon still has various configs of the latest M4 iPad Air at deal pricing based on the pre-price hike MSRP – they are up to $230 off on 512GB and as much as $350 off for the 1TB.

Stock is starting to run very thin at Amazon and the price is surely about to jump up significantly. There are only a few models left with dwindling stock on select colors, but there are still some options sitting at the pre-price hike Prime Day price:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,049 (Now Reg. $1,349)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $1,019 (Now Reg. $1,249)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,549)

Pricing on the M4 iPad Air just officially went up by between $150 and $250 depending on the storage capacity, as reflected in the regular prices above. However, with select models on Amazon still sitting at Prime Day pricing, we are looking at what is effectively the biggest deals we have tracked on these machines since release.

There’s no telling how long these price hikes might remain at Apple, but there’s no end in site at this point, leaving these machines at quite possibly the best prices we will see on the latest iPad Air in a long while.
